kv7.7:1.3: sukhavedaniyā, dukkhavedaniyā, adukkhamasukhavedaniyā, sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttā, dukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttā, adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttā, phassena sampayuttā, vedanāya sampayuttā, saññāya sampayuttā, cetanāya sampayuttā, cittena sampayuttā, sārammaṇā,
kv7.7:1.4: atthī tāya āvaṭṭanā ābhogo samannāhāro manasikāro cetanā patthanā paṇidhī’ti.
kv7.7:1.6: nanu na sukhavedaniyā, na dukkhavedaniyā, na adukkhamasukhavedaniyā, na sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttā, na dukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttā, na adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttā, na phassena sampayuttā, na vedanāya sampayuttā, na saññāya sampayuttā, na cetanāya sampayuttā, na cittena sampayuttā, anārammaṇā,
kv7.7:1.7: natthī tāya avaṭṭanā ābhogo samannāhāro manasikāro cetanā patthanā paṇidhī’ti.
kv7.7:1.11: natthī tāya āvaṭṭanā …pe… paṇidhī, no ca vata re vattabbe:
kv7.7:2.1: phasso kammavipāko. phasso sukhavedaniyo dukkhavedaniyo adukkhamasukhavedaniyo, sukhāya vedanāya sampayutto, dukkhāya …pe… adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayutto, phassena sampayutto, vedanāya sampayutto, saññāya sampayutto, cetanāya sampayutto, cittena sampayutto sārammaṇo,
kv7.7:2.4: paṭhavī kammavipāko. paṭhavī sukhavedaniyā dukkhavedaniyā adukkhamasukhavedaniyā, sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttā, dukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttā, adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttā, phassena sampayuttā, vedanāya sampayuttā, saññāya sampayuttā, cetanāya sampayuttā, cittena sampayuttā, sārammaṇā.
kv7.7:2.5: atthī tāya āvaṭṭanā ābhogo samannāhāro manasikāro cetanā patthanā paṇidhī’ti.
kv7.7:2.7: paṭhavī kammavipāko, paṭhavī na sukhavedaniyā, na dukkhavedaniyā …pe… anārammaṇā,
kv7.7:2.10: phasso kammavipāko, phasso na sukhavedaniyo, na dukkhavedaniyo …pe… anārammaṇo,
kv7.7:4.1: labbhā paṭhavī ketuṃ vikketuṃ āṭhapetuṃ ocinituṃ vicinitu’nti.
kv7.7:4.3: labbhā kammavipāko ketuṃ vikketuṃ āṭhapetuṃ ocinituṃ vicinitunti.
kv7.7:9.3: paṭhamaṃ paṭhavī saṇṭhāti, pacchā sattā uppajjantī’ti.
kv7.7:9.5: paṭhamaṃ vipāko uppajjati, pacchā vipākapaṭilābhāya kammaṃ karontī’ti.
kv7.7:11.9: cakkavattisattassa phassaṃ vedanaṃ saññaṃ cetanaṃ cittaṃ saddhaṃ viriyaṃ satiṃ samādhiṃ paññaṃ aññe sattā paribhuñjantī’ti.
